sentences.en: Isotactic diad decreases with the increase of radiation dose . Meanwhile, atactic and syndiotactic diad increases.

sentences.en: Assemble into a triad body or diad body. Its regulator knob in pressure regulating valve can be locked, to prevent the location changed in the process of working.

sentences.en: The present running situation on diad graphite synthetic furnace producing hydrogen chloride is introduced in the paper.

sentences.en: The application of ferreous synthetic furnace, triad graphite synthetic furnace and diad graphite synthetic furnace in the production of high purity hydrochloric acid is compared.
sentences.vi: So sánh ứng dụng của lò tổng hợp ferreous, lò tổng hợp graphit bộ ba và lò tổng hợp diad graphit trong sản xuất axit clohydric có độ tinh khiết cao.
